parameters.name: Note
parameters.description:
The comment on the invitation.

The comment can be up to 1,024 characters in length.

parameters.name: TargetEntity
parameters.description: The ID or logon email address of the account that you want to invite.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the account. Valid values:

*   Account: indicates the ID of the account.
*   Email: indicates the logon email address of the account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager invite-account-to-resource-directory --target-entity someone@example.com --target-type Email --note '欢迎您加入' --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager InviteAccountToResourceDirectory --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key k1 --Note '欢迎您加入' --Tag.1.Value v1 --TargetType Email --TargetEntity 'someone@example.com' --method POST --force
